## A Level · Chapters 23–37

The A Level chapters extend the same workflow with syllabus notes, worked examples, original diagrams and structured-question answers.

::: {.course-grid .a-level}

::: {.topic-card}
### [23 Chemical energetics](a-level/23-chemical-energetics.qmd)

- 23.1 Lattice energy & Born–Haber cycles：晶格能、原子化焓、电子亲和能、Born–Haber 循环与计算
- 23.2 Enthalpies of solution & hydration：溶解焓、水合焓、能量循环与影响水合焓的因素
- 23.3 Entropy change：熵的定义、状态与溶解过程的熵变、标准熵变计算
- 23.4 Gibbs free energy change：$\Delta G^\ominus=\Delta H^\ominus-T\Delta S^\ominus$、反应可行性判断与温度影响
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [24 Electrochemistry](a-level/24-electrochemistry.qmd)

- 24.1 Electrolysis：Faraday、$Q=It$、$F=Le$、electroplating 与 Avogadro constant calculations
- 24.2 Standard electrode potentials, standard cell potentials and the Nernst equation：SHE、half-cells、cell diagrams、salt bridge、$E^\ominus_{\mathrm{cell}}$、Nernst equation、Gibbs energy 与氧化还原可行性
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [25 Equilibria](a-level/25-equilibria.qmd)

- 25.1 Acids and bases：Brønsted–Lowry acids and bases、conjugate pairs、pH、$K_a$、p$K_a$、$K_w$、strong / weak acids、buffers、blood bicarbonate buffer、$K_{sp}$ 与 common-ion effect
- 25.2 Partition coefficients：$K_{pc}$ 定义、计算、相对溶解度与 solute / solvent polarity
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [26 Reaction kinetics](a-level/26-reaction-kinetics.qmd)

- 26.1 Simple rate equations, orders of reaction and rate constants：rate equation、orders、initial rates、graphs、half-life、$k$、mechanisms、rate-determining steps、Arrhenius relationship
- 26.2 Homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysts (AL)：adsorption、bond weakening、desorption、Haber process、catalytic converters、Fe$^{2+}$/Fe$^{3+}$ cycle 与 nitrogen oxides catalysis
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [27 Group 2](a-level/27-group-2.qmd)

- 27.1 Similarities and trends in the properties of the Group 2 metals, magnesium to barium, and their compounds (AL)：ionic radius、charge density、polarisation、nitrate/carbonate thermal stability、water reactions、hydroxide/sulfate solubility、lattice energy、hydration enthalpy 与 enthalpy of solution
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [28 Chemistry of transition elements](a-level/28-transition-elements.qmd)

- 28.1 General physical and chemical properties：transition element 定义、电子排布、variable oxidation states、complex formation、colour 和 catalysis
- 28.2 General characteristic chemical properties：ligands、coordination number、complex geometries、ligand exchange 与 redox catalysis
- 28.3 Colour of complexes：degenerate / non-degenerate d orbitals、octahedral / tetrahedral splitting、visible-light absorption 与 complementary colours
- 28.4 Stereoisomerism：cis–trans geometrical isomerism 与 optical isomerism
- 28.5 Stability constants：$K_{\mathrm{stab}}$ 表达式、ligand exchange 和稳定性比较
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [29 An introduction to A Level organic chemistry](a-level/29-organic-chemistry.qmd)

- 29.1 Formulas, Functional Groups - the Naming of Organic Compounds (AL)：functional groups、general / structural / displayed / skeletal formula、脂肪族与芳香族化合物的系统命名
- 29.2 Characteristic Organic Reactions (AL)：electrophilic substitution 与 addition–elimination 两类机制术语
- 29.3 Shapes of Aromatic Organic Molecules; σ - π Bonds：benzene 的平面结构、$sp^2$ hybridisation、$\sigma$ bonds 与 delocalised $\pi$ system
- 29.4 Isomerism Optical：chiral centre、enantiomers、plane-polarised light、racemic mixture 与 chiral catalysts 在药物合成中的意义
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [30 Hydrocarbons](a-level/30-hydrocarbons.qmd)

- 30.1 Arenes：benzene 的结构与芳香稳定性、electrophilic substitution、nitration、halogenation、Friedel–Crafts alkylation/acylation、methylbenzene 的 side-chain reactions、oxidation、hydrogenation、aryl halides 与合成路线
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [31 Halogen compounds](a-level/31-halogen-compounds.qmd)

- 31.1 Halogen compounds：benzene 与 methylbenzene 的 halogenation、electrophilic substitution、2,4-directing effects、side-chain free-radical substitution、halogenoalkanes 与 halogenoarenes 的 nucleophilic substitution reactivity、C–X bond 的 partial double-bond character 与 aromatic synthesis
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [32 Hydroxy compounds](a-level/32-hydroxy-compounds.qmd)

- 32.1 Alcohols (AL)：acyl chlorides、nucleophilic acyl substitution、ester formation 与 phenoxide 的生成
- 32.2 Phenol：weak acidity、phenoxide、bromination、nitration、diazonium coupling、1-naphthol 与 mesalamine synthesis
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [33 Carboxylic acids and derivatives](a-level/33-carboxylic-acids-and-derivatives.qmd)

- 33.1 Carboxylic acids：oxidation、weak acidity、carboxylate-ion delocalisation、substituent effects 与 acyl-chloride preparation
- 33.2 Esters：esterification、condensation、hydrolysis、naming 与 reversible equilibrium
- 33.3 Acyl chlorides：nucleophilic addition–elimination、hydrolysis、ester/amides/phenyl esters、relative reactivity 与 synthesis routes
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [34 Nitrogen compounds](a-level/34-nitrogen-compounds.qmd)

- 34.1 Primary and secondary amines：amine structures、basicity、halogenoalkane substitution、amide/nitrile reduction 与 acyl-chloride reactions
- 34.2 Phenylamine and azo compounds：nitrobenzene reduction、bromination、diazonium salts、azo coupling 与 azo dyes
- 34.3 Amides：formation、acid/alkaline hydrolysis、LiAlH₄ reduction 与 amides 的 weak basicity
- 34.4 Amino acids：zwitterions、isoelectric point、electrophoresis、peptide bonds 与 condensation polymers
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [35 Polymerisation](a-level/35-polymerisation.qmd)

- 35.1 Condensation Polymerisation：polyesters、polyamides、polyurethanes、amino-acid polymers、ester/amide/urethane links 与由 repeat unit 反推 monomers
- 35.2 Predicting the Type of Polymerisation：addition polymerisation、co-polymers、condensation polymerisation 的判断依据与结构识别
- 35.3 Degradable Polymers：polyalkenes 的难降解性、photodegradable polymers、polyester/polyamide 的 acid and alkaline hydrolysis
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [36 Organic synthesis](a-level/36-organic-synthesis.qmd)

- 36.1 Organic synthesis：multiple functional groups、functional-group interconversion、aromatic and aliphatic synthetic routes、multi-step synthesis 与 route analysis
- 重点掌握试剂和条件、反应类型、selectivity、by-products、separation，以及由目标分子倒推合成路线
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [37 Analytical techniques](a-level/37-analytical-techniques.qmd)

- 37.1 Thin-Layer Chromatography：stationary/mobile phases、$R_f$ values、spot identification 与实验设计
- 37.2 Gas-Liquid Chromatography：carrier gas、stationary phase、retention time、peak area 与 chromatogram interpretation
- 37.3 Carbon-13 NMR Spectroscopy：equivalent carbon environments、symmetry、chemical shifts 与 TMS reference
- 37.4 Proton (¹H) NMR Spectroscopy：chemical shift、integration、splitting、$n+1$ rule，以及 MS/IR/NMR 综合鉴定
:::

:::
